sections.text:
Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies 4 times with magic dark damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes buffs from all enemies.
-Casts prohibit Unison on all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Casts despair on all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Removes 20 Cost from all enemies.
-Recovers 20 Cost for all allies.
-Casts frenzy on your character for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 7500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 7500
[Additional Unison Effect] Applies a 60-second 10% Life Drain effect to all allies.
